description: This file defines the interface RepeatingCustomValueDescriptor, which describes how custom values that can repeat within an owning type are managed and stored in the OpenMRS system. It specifies methods to get minimum and maximum occurrence constraints.

classes.name: RepeatingCustomValueDescriptor
classes.description: An interface specifying behavior for repeating custom value descriptors, including methods to retrieve occurrence constraints.

methods.name: getMinOccurs
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of values of this type that must be present for the owner to be valid, should never return null.

methods.name: getMaxOccurs
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of values of this type that may be present for the owner to be valid, should never return a number less than or equal to zero.
